subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, and F are standing in a circle talking, facing the centre of the circle. E is standing immediate right to C. D is standing at the third position towards the left of C. A is standing at the second place towards the right of F. Who is standing to the immediate right of D?
solution:
**Explanation : **

 
• D is standing at the third position towards the left of C.
 
• E is standing immediate right to C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f5bcb61e05a3124033ec1c08fea8c315e886e8057aa06259576e3b738dda99f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2b777feeabdc61349f7acfd55cab4072f98d1bb15448bb2b6d192dd5e87d680.png] 

A is standing at the second place towards the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fd877cdbfaa508b8d12420a975680a546bdb585b61bd601a51d2ab45df164bf.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2ea91f8af6448b18a30696657f6746741912aa5e4757ea34170c2bd93e95ce6.png] 

A is standing to the immediate right of D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37d9fb5fb6babb47af7c2d4927c9a50c514264f455cba2ef3994599189dc0623.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2b8b763a05e73fc6d25ad09ff91a012857fce594e358f3ffd29a8735c962c39.png] 

Hence, **A **is the correct answer.
